points.reason: Remove redundant captured HWND and explanatory comment; use original Parm16.WndProc.wParam for AddInitiator.
points.evidence: CallBack16 copies PARM16 to guest and has no writeback to caller PARM16. Common dialog/window callers preserve it; ThunkMsgFilterHook uses a separate mpex for modified guest message. Current extra snapshot has no demonstrated necessity. Keep success marker: AddInitiator allocation failure must not authorize deletion of an outer same-HWND node.

points.reason: Remove redundant local HWND; use original Parm16.WndProc.wParam for DeleteInitiator after consuming success bit.
points.evidence: WI32DDEAddInitiator prepends only on allocation success; WI32DDEDeleteInitiator removes first matching HWND. Inner allocation failure with same HWND followed by original unconditional deletion removes outer node. Gate on successful insertion; original HWND parameter remains stable. No call occurs between clearing active and reading parameter, so local copy is unnecessary.
